proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense usage qualifier for item-mediated viewing
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can encode a timed Truesight grant, but it cannot encode that the granted sense only applies while the user is actively peering through the item during the active window.
proposed_widenings.evidence: For the next 10 minutes, you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.

notes: Authored and traced as a magic-item activation with a 3-charge pool and 1d3 dawn recharge. The main widening is the missing runtime qualifier on grant_sense. Also, pnpm typecheck failed in pre-existing tracer code at src/interpreter/tracer.ts:3274, and the tracer output omitted the authored 10-minute duration lifecycle nodes.
